children: SinterCast proposes issuing 785,300 shares to Daimler Truck AG at SEK 101.53 per share, plus 461,912 warrants at no cost, subject to shareholder approval. The proposed investment is linked to a commercial agreement with Atlantis Foundries.
The directed issue would bring in cash and give Daimler Truck a strategic stake; the release provides no total proceeds figure.
Exercise could add shares and increase Daimler Truck’s investment, creating potential future dilution.
Warrant exercise price set by future 12-month VWAP
The eventual exercise price is not fixed today, limiting certainty about proceeds and dilution.
The proposed board expansion from five to six seats would add a representative of the strategic investor.
The investment and board changes remain conditional on shareholder approval and completion of the subscription.

This is a proposed strategic investment tied to a commercial agreement, rather than a completed transaction or a reported operating result. Shareholder approval and completion of the share and warrant subscriptions are needed before the investment and related board changes take effect.
